title: Underlying Stokes and de Rham structures for Arnold-type invariants
summary: We introduce a framework on dual complexes for studying Arnold-type invariants of immersed curves and immersed surfaces via local finite-difference structures associated with Alexander numberings. For generic immersed plane curves and generic immersed surfaces, we define locally normalized maps $d^k φ$ on dual skeleta and show that suitable evaluations recover the Arnold-type invariants $St_{(1)}$ and $St_{(2)}$.
